customManagers.description: The clang22 release ed25519 is built with: its Linux archive on Linux, verified against components/clang22/sha256, and its clang22-cross pkg on a Mac that has not installed that release.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/clang22/version but cannot vouch for the new Linux archive, so the Linux build fails at the fetch until components/clang22/sha256 is written for it.
prBodyNotes: The Linux build fails until components/clang22/sha256 is the new release's linux-x86_64 archive digest. .github/workflows/pins-bot.yml writes it on this branch with `sh build/pin-clang22.sh fill`; if that bot failed, run `sh build/pin-clang22.sh` on this branch (it checks the archive against the release's SHA256SUMS) and commit the file.
